title: AgentFW Security Event
description: One JSON event per PEP decision (AGENTFW_CONTEXT.md §3, §7). Written to the event store before the action is released — an event that fails to validate against this schema must be treated as a log failure and denies the action (log-or-deny).

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this schema.

timestamp.description: UTC, set by the PEP at stage 8 (durable log), not by the agent.

trace_id.description: Correlates every event belonging to one tool call across pipeline stages.

session_id.description: Correlates every event belonging to one agent session — the unit session_taint is scoped to.

role.description: The role policy is keyed on, not the agent's network location.

fqdn.description: The canonical form produced by pep/normalize.py — never the raw agent-supplied string.

ip.description: Resolved IP, set once the PEP has pinned fqdn to it (closes the DNS-rebinding TOCTOU gap).

resource.description: Path, query, table name, or file path being acted on — whatever is specific below the destination.

session_taint.description: Monotonic for the session (invariant §3.5) — set by the PEP, never by the agent.

risk_factors.description: Every contributing factor, non-negotiable — a risk score that can't explain itself is unresolvable at 3am.

policy_id.description: The matched rule ID, or the DEFAULT_DENY sentinel when no explicit rule matched.

policy_bundle_version.description: Strictly monotonic version string — answers 'which policy allowed this?' during an audit.

decision.description: A point on the monotonic lattice (AGENTFW_CONTEXT.md §2), lowest to highest privilege.

reason.description: Machine-checkable reason code plus human-readable text, e.g. 'taint_ceiling' or 'matched_explicit_allow'.

latency_ms.description: Per-stage breakdown of the 8-stage pipeline — each metric names the optimization it enables.
